t: An elementary CodeHS course that teaches coding with Ozobot color codes on paper.
steps: Find the Coding with Ozobot course on the CodeHS site.
Contact CodeHS for the lesson materials.
Obtain Ozobot robots, paper and color markers.
Ask CodeHS whether accounts and internet are needed.
Read the lesson plans and slides.
Test a color code on paper with one robot.
Teach the first lesson to a small group.
